name: Internal Audit Finding
description: Nonconformity raised during an internal quality audit.

name: External Audit Finding
description: Finding raised by a certification body or client auditor.

name: Customer Complaints
description: Nonconformity traced to a customer complaint or return.

name: Key Performance Indicator
description: Objective or target not met for the monitoring period.

name: Management Review Action Item
description: Action item arising from management review.

name: External Service Provider
description: Nonconformity attributed to a supplier or subcontractor.

name: QMS System Deviation
description: Deviation from the documented quality management system.

name: Incoming QC NC
description: Nonconformity detected at incoming quality control.

name: Other Identified NC
description: Any other identified nonconformity. Requires specification.
